subject: Physics
note: This is the 45-mark COMPULSORY Paper 3 Section A only. A-level Physics Paper 3 total is 80 marks after adding ONE chosen 35-mark Section B option (3BA/3BB/3BC/3BD/3BE); options must be separately indexed and NOT added together as if one candidate takes all five. Original copyrighted question wording/diagrams not reproduced.
markingWarnings: 01.1 requires figure annotation as well as a textual measurement description; typing alone cannot certify diagram credit.
01.3 and 01.6 require prediction-test reasoning, not mere mention of an inverse-square relationship.
01.7 is one mark for a numerical result; measurement precision matters.
01.8 includes a dependent reasoning step based on stochastic arrivals; a keyword checker would over-award.
02.1 requires a wavelength read from a graph, substitution, and accurate derived value; accept appropriate carry-forward according to the mark scheme.
02.3 requires graph extrapolation; one copied number may omit visual evidence.
02.4 allows alternative valid optical data paths, with mark criteria and rounding rules.
03.3 partial uncertainty marks depend on sound method, not just final percent.
03.5 and 03.6 are evaluation/explanation marks and should not be reduced to independent keywords.
03.7 and 03.8 use graph readings and consequential numeric steps, subject to official marking instructions.
Paper Section B option differs by the student's AQA entry code; never claim Section A alone is the full Paper 3.
verification: Question/mark brackets independently checked from the official 28-page AQA 7408/3A question paper and 22-page final mark scheme; the mark scheme numbers pages internally June 2021 although the official release is November 2021. Editorial topic labels are original paraphrases.
copyrightNote: No original AQA text, image, complete answer key or operational laboratory instructions reproduced. Audit is METADATA ONLY and does not add student-visible question parts.
